text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- On his return from his official visit to China and the United States Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov said that political cooperation opened the way to economic cooperation.
- Macedonian Parliament Speaker Tito Petkovski left for Helsinki to attend the European transport conference.
- A clash was avoided at the protest rally of depositors of the collapsed TAT financial institution on Saturday thanks to the cool-headed leaders and speedy withdrawal of the police cordon.
- Reconstruction of Skopje airport is almost complete, installation of the lighting system to be ended in mid-July. The works are woth 19 million German marks.

- According to official data of the Macedonian finance ministry given to the Association of hard currency depositors there are three depositors with several million German marks, 33 with one million and 1,697 with half a million German marks frozen in hard currency savings in Macedonia. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
